analysis_name: Executive Summary vs Benchmark Table Reconciliation
mechanism: AchievementRecorder is an in-memory accumulator initialized in train_agent.py. When a run is resumed from a checkpoint where env_step >= target_env_steps (or at the boundary), the collection while-loop does not execute any steps. The freshly instantiated AchievementRecorder has 0 recorded episodes. Consequently, achievement_recorder.get_summary() reports 0 episodes, which report_gen writes into final_report.md Section 1. Meanwhile, achievement_rates.csv retains prior rows from the initial run before disconnect (e.g., 296 and 280 episodes at ~2.1-2.2% Crafter score).

post_resume_run.reason: Resumed directly at step 50,000 / 50,000 without restoring prior AchievementRecorder episode buffer.

recommendation: Persist AchievementRecorder episode history and running totals in CheckpointStore dictionary.
